note: Volume UUIDs of the 22H374 images this board installs, uppercase as diskutil and IOMedia print them, read from the APFS volume headers of the flashed userdata image (scripts/prepare-pong-userland-from-ipsw.py --volume-layout-out). The kernel binds the OS, SystemOS and Data volumes to these; the ADT /chosen/root-matching dictionary names the OS one as well.
